assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: editorial illustration for a professional hackathon pitch deck about direct conversations between a visiting AI agent and a website-specific expert agent. Primary request: a premium sculptural still life showing exactly two large three-dimensional conversation glyphs facing one another, linked by one short elegant lime-green connector. One glyph is matte ivory with a fine dark edge; the other is deep forest green. They have the familiar simple chat-bubble silhouette and are solid sculptural objects, not flat UI panels. Style: refined contemporary industrial-design render, calm Swiss editorial taste, precise soft bevels, realistic matte ceramic texture, subtle restrained shadows, no shine. Composition: square image, centered pair of sculptures occupying most of the frame with generous clear space around the objects, eye-level shallow perspective. Colors: ivory #F7F7F2, charcoal #20231E, forest #304C3C, restrained lime #C4DF92. Background: genuinely transparent, preserve alpha around the whole pair and its subtle shadows. The metaphor is one direct conversation, equal counterpart agents. No text, letters, numbers, logos, webpage, browser screen, icons inside bubbles, robot faces, people, flowers, particles, network mesh, dashboards, gradients, glow, chrome, or watermark. Deliver a polished high-resolution isolated illustration, with each conversation shape clearly separated and the linking piece visible between them.
